column_description: A BIGSERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each record of conservation and maintenance.
A CHAR(10) NOT NULL foreign key referencing ArtifactsCore(ArtRegistry). Ties this record to the maintained artifact.
A CHAR(8) foreign key referencing ExhibitionHalls(HallRegistry), if the conservation applies to a specific hall area.
A BIGINT foreign key referencing SurfaceAndPhysicalReadings(SurfPhysRegistry). Links to surface/physical readings used in this maintenance record.
A VARCHAR(50) describing the status of conservation treatment (possible values: 'In Progress', 'Not Required', 'Scheduled').
A CHAR(10) indicating the priority of the treatment (possible values: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Urgent').
A DATE specifying the last cleaning date of the artifact/hall/showcase.
A DATE indicating when the next cleaning is scheduled or recommended.
A SMALLINT capturing the recommended cleaning interval in days.
A TEXT field describing any notes, log details, or issues encountered during maintenance activities (possible values: 'Updated', 'Pending', 'Review').
A VARCHAR(50) summarizing the status of any incident reports (possible values: 'Closed', 'Open').
A CHAR(15) indicating whether emergency drills are 'Current', 'Overdue', 'Due', etc.
A VARCHAR(20) describing staff training status (possible values: 'Current', 'Overdue', 'Due').
A VARCHAR(50) describing budget allocation status (possible values: 'Review Required', 'Insufficient', 'Adequate').
A CHAR(15) indicating if the current maintenance budget is 'Limited', 'Depleted', 'Available', etc.
A VARCHAR(30) describing the frequency of conservation efforts (possible values: 'Rare', 'Occasional', 'Frequent').
A TEXT field detailing the intervention or treatment history (possible values: 'Extensive', 'Minimal', 'Moderate').
A SMALLINT counting how many significant treatments have been done previously on this artifact/hall.
A VARCHAR(100) summarizing how effective previous treatments were (possible values: 'Low', 'Medium', 'High').
A TEXT field describing if and how treatments can be reversed (possible values: 'Medium', 'High', 'Low').
